A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same optimized linear measurement (OLM) study. All 25 pages, including Appendices A–F, equations, figures and tables, are readable and support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v3 reports original two-dimensional simulations and MNIST/CelebA reconstruction experiments, including quantitative performance, robustness analyses and reconstructed images in Section 3 and the appendices.

after.justification: v4 retains these original simulations, reconstruction experiments and supplementary analyses, including the work's own results in Appendix F.

M1.justification: The OLM optimization, denoiser architecture, objectives and constrained sampling procedure are retained. Algorithm 1 changes d_t to the already-defined residual s_t, repairing an inconsistent variable name without establishing a procedural change.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same Gaussian, sparse and curved-manifold synthetic examples, MNIST digits and grayscale CelebA faces. The measurement-noise scenarios are also retained.

E2.justification: The PCA, random-measurement and ICA comparisons are unchanged. Appendix F, Table 1 retains the same LASSO (Wavelet), VAE/GAN-prior and learned linear/nonlinear comparators attributed to Bora et al. and Wu et al.

E3.justification: Appendix E retains the same preprocessing, 512-image test sets, training budgets, metrics and conditional-sample counts. The principal-angle notation correction leaves the stated SVD-based distance calculation and its reported evaluation unchanged.

E4.justification: The measurement-statistics analyses, sequential OLM comparison and measurement-noise tests in Figure 4 are unchanged. Supplementary Figure 1 retains the same parameter-sensitivity analysis, and Supplementary Figures 2–4 retain the same prior visualizations and reconstruction examples.

E5.justification: Table 1 retains the same mean and standard-error reporting. No repeated-run counts, seed information, confidence intervals or significance-testing procedures are added or revised.

E6.justification: All main and supplementary result entries are retained. Figure 3 still reports peak OLM-versus-PC gains of 4.72 dB for MNIST at k = 256 and 0.44 dB for CelebA at k = 2048, both using the denoiser prior.

T1.justification: Appendix B, Equation (14) restores the missing subscript in the quadratic term m_i^T X X^T m_i. Appendix E.5, Equation (15) corrects the first maximization variable from v_k in F to u_k in F. These locally repair a derivation and a formal definition without adding new theoretical results.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims about improved reconstruction, dependence on dataset and reconstruction objective, and differences between OLMs and PCA, ICA or random measurements.

C2.justification: The interpretations of measurement statistics, the SSIM–PSNR tradeoff and noise robustness are unchanged. Section 5 retains the same limitations concerning computational expense, nonsequential measurements, interpretability and realistic measurement constraints.

D1.justification: The architecture descriptions, preprocessing, hyperparameters, hardware, runtimes and code-access information are unchanged. Algorithm 1's variable-name correction resolves an internal notation inconsistency without disclosing new implementation settings.

R1.justification: Section 4 and the bibliography retain the same cited works and research positioning, including relationships to compressed sensing, learned image priors and earlier measurement-optimization methods.

P1.justification: Edits are limited to symbol/index corrections and the arXiv version/date stamp. Section 2.4 changes u^i to u_i, and Algorithm 1 replaces the undefined d_t with s_t. The prose, section order and appendix organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1–5, Supplementary Figures 1–4 and Table 1 retain their contents, captions, structure and placement. The localized mathematical corrections do not reorganize the page layout or alter the visual displays.

improvement.justification: v4 improves mathematical and pseudocode consistency by repairing the PCA derivation, principal-angle definition and undefined sampling-update variable. These corrections remove small ambiguities for readers interpreting or implementing the work. The empirical evidence, claims and limitations remain unchanged, so the overall benefit is limited.
